user.title: Choose a Lumalou
user.description: Choose a connectable Lumalou candidate discovered by Home Assistant.

data_description.address: Only connectable advertisements matching the known Lumalou pattern are shown. Confirm the product label before hardware testing.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Add {name}?
bluetooth_confirm.description: Check the product code printed on the device label. Only GLD09 is supported. The entry starts with a background read-only state request and never changes settings automatically.

data_description.product_code: Enter GLD09 exactly as confirmed on the physical device label. The advertisement alone cannot prove the model.

reconfigure.title: Confirm Lumalou product code
reconfigure.description: This legacy entry remains read-only until the supported GLD09 code is confirmed from the physical device label.

data_description.product_code: Enter GLD09 exactly as confirmed on the physical device label.

error.device_unavailable: The selected device is no longer available. Try again.
error.unsupported_product_code: Only product code GLD09 is supported. Check the physical device label.

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration for this device is already in progress.
abort.no_devices_found: No connectable advertisements matching the known Lumalou pattern were found.
abort.not_connectable: This Bluetooth path cannot connect to the device.
abort.unsupported_device: The advertisement does not match the known Lumalou pattern.

init.title: Edit Lumalou
init.description: Choose behavior options or a private profile editor. Profile edits are saved offline and are not sent to the device.

behavior.title: Behavior options
behavior.description: Automatic restore is unavailable until full profile readback and hardware validation are complete. Maintenance mode is controlled separately on the device page.

data_description.auto_restore: Reserved for a future verified implementation. It cannot currently be enabled.

basic.title: Light and audio values
basic.description: These are private saved-profile values only. If a value was never saved, 0 is shown as a new draft value; it remains unknown until you confirm this editor. Nothing is sent to the device.

playlist.title: Ordered playlist
playlist.description: Use fixed rows to preserve order and duplicates. Clear every row for an empty playlist. If no playlist was saved, these rows are a new empty draft and stay unknown until confirmation. Nothing is sent to the device.

clock_settings.title: Clock settings
clock_settings.description: This editor saves one complete private clock-settings block. If absent, shown defaults are new draft values: display off, brightness 0, 12-hour format. Nothing is sent to the device.

routine_settings.title: Routine settings
routine_settings.description: This editor saves one complete private routine-settings block. If absent, shown defaults are new draft values: disabled and numeric values 0. Music and volume are raw validated bytes, not named modes. Nothing is sent to the device.

schedule.title: Weekly Ready-to-Rise and Sleepy times
schedule.description: A disabled time is stored as no time. An enabled 00:00 time is stored as midnight. The time control remains visible when disabled; the switch determines which value is saved.

schedule_alarm.title: Weekly alarm offsets
schedule_alarm.description: Choose each day's source-defined alarm offset and one alarm sound. Sound numbers are preserved exactly; hardware behavior is not yet verified.

routine.title: Choose a routine day
routine.description: Each day stores an independent routine.

routine_tasks.title: Edit daily routine
routine_tasks.description: Rows are stored in order. Clear a row to remove it. Existing source task ID 0 rows are retained but are not shown as a named choice. Drag-and-drop reordering is unavailable in Home Assistant options flows; move choices between fixed rows instead.

routine_copy.title: Copy routine
routine_copy.description: Optionally replace routines on selected days with independent copies of this routine.

schedule_confirm.title: Confirm weekly schedule
schedule_confirm.description: Revision {revision}: {ready_count} Ready-to-Rise times, {sleepy_count} Sleepy times, {alarm_count} enabled alarms, alarm sound {alarm_sound}. Saving changes only the private profile; it does not write to the device.

routine_confirm.title: Confirm daily routine
routine_confirm.description: Revision {revision}: {day}, {task_count} task rows, {copy_count} matching copied days, {zero_count} preserved unnamed task ID 0 rows. Saving changes only the private profile; it does not write to the device.

basic_confirm.title: Confirm light and audio values
basic_confirm.description: Revision {revision}: brightness {brightness}, color {color}, light duration {light_duration}, volume {volume}, playlist duration {playlist_duration}. Saving changes only the private profile; it does not write to the device.

playlist_confirm.title: Confirm playlist
playlist_confirm.description: Revision {revision}: {song_count} song rows: {songs}. Saving changes only the private profile; it does not write to the device.

clock_settings_confirm.title: Confirm clock settings
clock_settings_confirm.description: Revision {revision}: display {display}, brightness {brightness}, format {format}. Saving changes only the private profile; it does not write to the device.

routine_settings_confirm.title: Confirm routine settings
routine_settings_confirm.description: Revision {revision}: enabled {enabled}, music {music}, volume {volume}, task reward sound {task_reward_sfx}, routine reward sound {routine_reward_sfx}. Saving changes only the private profile; it does not write to the device.

error.auto_restore_unavailable: Automatic restore is not available in this version.
error.invalid_alarm: Choose a supported alarm offset and sound.
error.invalid_routine: Use no more than 12 supported task rows and a valid minute-resolution time.
error.invalid_basic: Choose supported light and audio values.
error.invalid_playlist: Use at most 12 song IDs from 1 through 18.
error.invalid_clock_settings: Choose a supported clock display, brightness, and format.
error.invalid_routine_settings: Use whole-byte music and volume values and supported reward sounds.
error.revision_conflict: The profile changed while this editor was open. Cancel and reopen it to use the latest revision.
error.profile_save_failed: The profile could not be saved. Nothing from this draft was applied.

abort.profile_editor_unavailable: Load the Lumalou entry before editing its private profile.

refresh_state.description: Request a fresh read-only state snapshot from Lumalou.

sync_clock.name: Synchronize clock
sync_clock.description: Set the Lumalou clock from the Home Assistant time zone.

export_profile.name: Export profile
export_profile.description: Return the private saved profile and its current revision for backup and conflict-safe import.

import_profile.name: Import profile
import_profile.description: Validate and save a private profile without sending raw protocol commands.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: Lumalou configuration entry that owns the profile.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Profile object previously exported by this integration.

expected_revision.name: Expected revision
expected_revision.description: Required current revision used to reject concurrent edits.

restore_profile.name: Restore profile
restore_profile.description: Unavailable until upstream full-profile readback and hardware validation are complete.

set_maintenance.name: Set maintenance mode
set_maintenance.description: Release Bluetooth and block device operations while using an external controller.
